name: Inpweb Ad Spaces
author: Inp-web

sections.description:
Inpweb Ad Spaces is the professional tool for website owners and entrepreneurs who want to monetize their traffic without the complexity of big ad networks. Manage your own sponsors and keep 100% of the profits.

Whether you want to handle sales manually via WhatsApp or build a fully automated SaaS-style business, this plugin adapts to your workflow. Insert elegant, high-conversion ad slots anywhere on your site using simple shortcodes.

Lite Version Features (Free)

  • Professional Dashboard: A clean, modern interface to manage your rates and settings.
  • Shortcode System: Total control with [inpweb_espacio tipo="lateral" id="L1"].
  • Direct WhatsApp Sales: Potential advertisers connect with you instantly with a pre-filled message.
  • Premium Design: Pre-styled ad boxes that look great on any WordPress theme.
  • Manual Expiration: Full control over when to show or hide active ads.

Pro Features (Unlock Your Potential)

  • Stripe Automation: Let your advertisers pay and reserve spaces 24/7. Funds go straight to your bank account.
  • AI Anti-Competitor Filter: Powered by Google Gemini, the system analyzes ads and automatically blocks your direct competition.
  • Advanced Analytics: Real-time tracking of impressions and clicks, exportable to Excel.
  • High-Impact Formats: Unlock Banner and Full-Width ad formats for maximum revenue.

Get your PRO license at Inp-web.com and join the Focus Formula productivity ecosystem.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the inpweb-ad-spaces folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the Ad Spaces menu in your dashboard to set your pricing.
  4. If using the Lite version, ensure your WhatsApp number is correctly formatted in Settings.
  5. Place your shortcodes in pages, posts, or widgets to start selling!
sections.faq:
Is this compatible with any theme?

Yes! We built Inpweb Ad Spaces using clean, modern CSS that inherits your site’s font styles while maintaining a high-end “Premium” look for the ads.

How does the AI Filter work?

This is a game-changer. In the PRO version, you can tell the AI (Google Gemini) what your business is about. If a competitor tries to buy an ad to “steal” your customers, the AI detects it and blocks the transaction automatically.

Do I need a Stripe account?

Only if you want to use the automated payment features (PRO). For the Lite version, all you need is a WhatsApp number to close deals manually with your sponsors.

Can I export reports for my advertisers?

Yes. The PRO version allows you to generate professional Excel reports showing exactly how many people saw and clicked on their ads. It’s the best way to prove the value of your site.

Why use Inpweb over other ad plugins?

Because we focus on Conversion and Simplicity. Most plugins are cluttered and ugly. Inpweb Ad Spaces is designed by developers who understand that an elegant dashboard and a fast user experience are what lead to real sales.
